title.narrative: Appuyer les moyens de subsistance des personnes en situation d'insécurité alimentaire ou à risque d'insécurité alimentaire

description.narrative: The main objective of this $2.5m WFP project is to reinforce communities’ adaptation capacity in the face of drought risk. To that end, WFP will construct 90,000 small-scale water catchments through a cash for assets initiative engaging 6,000 households. This will cover 1,700 hectares of agricultural and pastoral land. In addition, WFP will provide unconditional cash to 6,000 households along with FAO’s seed distribution. WFP will also raise awareness about climate risks via radio. In total, WFP will target 48,000 people including 10,800 women and 14,400 girls. Among those targeted, WFP expects to be 2,400 people with disabilities.
